subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**making**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the role of bacteria in the creation of various food items like cheese and pickles.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate the process of creating these food items.
 
• "**Making**" fits well as it denotes the process of producing or creating something, aligning with the context of food production.
 
• Other options ("**changing**", "**converting**", "**causing**") do not fit as well as "**making**" in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Curd contains several microorganisms. Of these, the bacterium, Lactobacillus promotes__ the formation of curd. It multiplies in milk and **__converts__ it into curd. Bacteria are also involved in the **__making__** of cheese, pickles and many other food items. Bacteria and yeast are also helpful for the fermentation of rice idlis and dosa batter. Yeast ____(4)____ rapidly and produces carbon dioxide during respiration. Bubbles of the gas fill the dough and increase its ____(5)____ . This is the basis of the use of yeast in the baking industry for making bread, pastries and cakes.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Changing**: "Changing" implies altering the state or form, but does not directly denote the creation of a product.
 
• **Converting**: "Converting" implies changing one form into another, similar to "changing", but less direct for food production.
 
• **Causing**: "Causing" means to make something happen, which is too indirect in this context.
